user.title: Split scheduler
user.description: Default profiles (Frost protection, Eco, Comfort, Boost…) and plannings (Normal, Holidays, Long absence) are created. Then create your split groups and their programs with the integration's **Configure** button.

init.title: Split scheduler
init.description: Choose what to edit. **Remember to “Save and close”**, otherwise changes are lost.

group_add.description: **Caution:** all splits of a group are assumed to be connected to the **same compressor** (same outdoor unit). If not, create one group per outdoor unit, otherwise compressor start counts will be wrong.

profile_add.title: New profile
profile_add.description: Empty fields are left unchanged on the splits. A profile without any setting (“Manual”) changes nothing. Target accepted by your splits: {limits} (out-of-range values are brought into range).

data_description.fan_mode: Values offered by your splits; you can also type one.
data_description.temperature: Ignored in Off and Fan only modes.
data_description.outdoor_max_delta: Cooling: the target never goes more than this gap below the outdoor temperature (1 h average); e.g. 26 °C with a 10 °C gap gives 29 °C when it is 39 °C outside. Heating: the target never goes more than this gap above it. Empty: no adaptation.

settings.title: General settings
settings.description: The outdoor temperature is used by profiles with a **maximum gap to outdoor**, for all groups. It is averaged over 60 minutes; the adapted target is sent at most every 30 minutes, only if it changes by at least 0.5 °C, and never when a profile change is due within 30 minutes. Without a valid value for an hour, the profile target applies.

data_description.outdoor_sensor: Empty: Faikout's “Outside” sensor (outdoor unit probe), detected automatically. It can be skewed while the unit runs, especially when cooling: a shaded sensor or weather station is more reliable.
